params.message:
Catalog Mistral (EU endpoint) and Haiku 5.5 so the verify tier can be measured on a European third family

The verify tier lost its third model family on 2026-08-27 when Together took
DeepSeek off serverless; the judge has sat on Sonnet since, with a known lean
toward Model A (documented in DEFAULTS). Mistral is an EU
provider under commercial terms with a DPA and an EU-only endpoint, and its
API is OpenAI-compatible, so it fits callOpenAICompat as it is.

- provider mistral on api.eu.mistral.ai (1.1x list price), key MISTRAL_API_KEY
- Mistral Small 4 (reasoning off, a verdict must not think out loud) and
  Mistral Large 3, priced at list x 1.1 from docs.mistral.ai, read 2026-10-09
- Claude Haiku 5.5 in both Claude catalogs at $0.10/$0.50 so eval-models
  can measure it against the gold set before classify moves
- the Mistral key is declared to Elixir like the Together key, with its
  proof and its refusals
- no phase default changes: nothing runs on Mistral or Haiku 5.5 until it
  has passed eval-models
